notes: Python runtime moved into yara_app/
Legacy Windows launchers moved into scripts/windows/
Tauri generated schemas and build caches removed from the source tree
Diagnostics schedule lookup optimized through schtasks with PowerShell fallback
Worker schedule starter fixed to use the project root
Worker reuses the logged-in Chromium context instead of opening TikTok twice
Worker self-test and maintenance actions added to the desktop app
Pinned auto-refresh control, TikTok Heart branding, and run history panel added
Desktop shell renamed to app_shell and UI dark background mode added
Pytest runtime isolated from the real profile and logs
UI performance panel added for slow local API requests
Manual refresh now queues behind in-flight auto-refresh
Auto-refresh uses a lightweight live status endpoint
Desktop shell owns its backend process and does not reuse stale servers
Auth backup restore added with validation and pre-restore safety backup
Worker lifecycle timeline added to the overview
Live status now has a short backend cache to reduce UI polling load
Windows launchers now use a shared robust Python discovery path
Scheduled starts validate worker command and creation time instead of trusting saved PIDs
Worker locks recover when Windows reuses an old PID after reboot
Worker exit clears its saved PID and releases its lock even if state cleanup fails
Windows startup launcher translates boot-force and self-test switches for PowerShell
Stale worker state cannot terminate an unrelated process
